headline: Launcher 0.3.0 brings disc-based setup to the native port
summary: Launcher 0.3.0 was released with setup from the player's own disc and a single game page with a Play button. Same-day development added packaged setup tools, macOS play support and level export before launch. Despite master's current release-only role, these changes landed directly on the branch.
highlights: Windows, Linux and macOS installer builds now carry the game, Python and setup tools.
The NTSC-U port builds and reaches the title screen, but stops later.
All PAL levels passed 1,500-tick startup runs, which do not establish full campaign playability.
Escape pauses the game, while launcher controls add stepping, speed changes and screenshots.
